_comment: The 1A spec cuts 26 series to 12-14. This is that cut - the single place
it is defined. Changing a slug here changes the Works index, the sitemap
and which images get derived; nothing else needs editing.
Needs Julia's sign-off. Dropped slugs still have live indexed URLs -
see seo/url-map.csv for where each should redirect at cutover.
_categories_note: Derived from scale: works with fixed object dimensions read as sculpture, room-scale or variable ones as installation. The spec also lists a 'public art' filter - that needs Julia to tag which works were public commissions, since the CMS records no such field. Add a 'public-art' key here and the filter appears.
_orphans_note: seo/url-map.csv marks these two KEEP+301 because they hold unique content on the retired /artwork/ tree. They exist only in the Chinese CMS collection, were never copied to the English one, and are outside the 14-work cut - so they redirect like the other dropped works rather than being rebuilt. Lost and Found (2021) was shown in The Miscellaneous of Being and Living.
_dropped_note: Dropped by the 1A cut. Each is a live indexed URL today; these are the 301 targets for cutover. Values are paths, not slugs.
